changes.before: Active as of 2026-09-23, confirmed via the county's own press release and independent news coverage. Resolution No. 26-18 (adopted 2026-07-21) bars submittal, issuance, review, or approval of permits for data centers and cable landing stations countywide (both pending and future applications) through 2027-07-21 or until rescinded, and holds related Board of Zoning Appeals proceedings pending. The pause froze the county's disputed determination that a proposed Globalinx cable landing station near the Ocean City Municipal Airport is not a permitted public utility use in its C-2 zoning district; Globalinx's BZA appeal of that determination remains blocked from proceeding while the moratorium is in effect. As of September 2026, Amazon had separately pivoted away from the original cable-landing/data-center concept toward a smaller power-feed facility proposal, and the county held further public sessions on cable landing stations and data centers (including one scheduled 2026-10-06).
